title: Godrej's ₹3,100 crore in Upper Kharadi: revenue potential, not investment, and not on MahaRERA yet
audience: Buyers, 28-50, budget ₹2-4 crore, waiting for the Godrej Upper Kharadi launch or being offered an early 'EOI'; English
message: Godrej's ₹3,100 crore Upper Kharadi figure (June 2025) is revenue potential from 16 acres and about 2.5 million sq ft, not money invested; we found no MahaRERA registration on 18 October 2026, and a project without one cannot legally advertise or take bookings.
facts: On 17 June 2025 Godrej Properties told the stock exchange it will develop a 16-acre land parcel in Upper Kharadi, Pune: premium group housing and high-street retail, about 2.5 million sq ft, estimated revenue potential about ₹3,100 crore. Source: NSE filing, 17 June 2025.
Revenue potential is what the company expects to sell, not the money it has invested.
On 2 June 2025 Godrej announced a separate 14-acre parcel in the Kharadi-Wagholi area with about ₹4,200 crore revenue potential.
Avasetu found no MahaRERA registration for Godrej in Kharadi or Wagholi when it read the register on 18 October 2026.
Under the RERA Act, a project must be registered with MahaRERA before it is advertised, marketed, booked or sold.

shots.prompt: (own picture: guide Godrej row in projects table)
shots.voice: You have heard Godrej put 3,100 crore into Upper Kharadi. That is not what the filing says.

shots.prompt: (own picture: guide bullet on revenue potential)
shots.voice: 3,100 crore is revenue potential: what Godrej expects to sell from 16 acres.
The plan is about 2.5 million square feet of premium flats and high-street retail.

shots.prompt: (own picture: guide FAQ, Has Godrej launched)
shots.voice: We found no MahaRERA registration for it when we checked on 18 October 2026.
Without a MahaRERA number, a project cannot legally advertise or take bookings.
If anyone asks for a token for Godrej Upper Kharadi, ask for the MahaRERA number first.

📄 Godrej Properties' filing (17 June 2025): 16 acres in Upper Kharadi, premium flats + high-street retail, ~2.5 million sq ft, revenue potential ~₹3,100 crore
💡 Revenue potential = what they expect to sell. Not money invested.
🔎 MahaRERA on 18 Oct 2026: no Godrej registration in Kharadi or Wagholi yet
⚖️ Under RERA, a project can't be advertised, booked or sold before it's registered
